body.statement: Under \(\mathrm{ass{:}primitive\text{-}compatibility}\), both the full causal model \(\mathcal M\) and the exact projected nuisance class \(\mathscr K\) are nonempty.  A common witness may be chosen with uniform stratum masses, density \(g_0\) in every stratum, identically zero potential outcomes, and independent centered error laws that are asymmetric and mutually nonidentical and whose \(q_e\)-moments are at most \(M_e/2\).
body.proof_tex:
We first verify that the objects in \(\mathrm{def{:}reference\text{-}bump}\) are well defined.  The function \(\widetilde g_0\) is positive on \((-B_A,B_A)\), bounded, and supported on \(\mathcal A=[-B_A,B_A]\).  Hence
\[
 0<\int_{\mathbb R}\widetilde g_0(v)\,dv<\infty,
\]
so \(g_0\) is a nonnegative probability density supported on \(\mathcal A\).  Repeated differentiation on \((-B_A,B_A)\) expresses every derivative of \(\widetilde g_0\) as a finite sum of a rational function of \(B_A^2-a^2\) multiplied by \(\exp\{-1/(B_A^2-a^2)\}\).  Since \(x^{-m}e^{-1/x}\to0\) as \(x\downarrow0\) for every integer \(m\ge0\), all one-sided derivatives vanish at \(\pm B_A\).  Thus \(g_0\in C_c^\infty(\mathbb R)\).  For an integer \(m>\beta+1/2\), integration by parts gives \(|\widehat g_0(t)|\le C_m(1+|t|)^{-m}\), so
\[
 \int_{\mathbb R}(1+t^2)^\beta|\widehat g_0(t)|^2\,dt<\infty.
\]
Consequently \(R_{f,0}=\|g_0\|_{H^\beta}<\infty\).  The function \(g_0\) is continuous and strictly positive on \(\operatorname{int}(\mathcal A)\).  Because \(I\) is compact and contained in that interior by \(\mathrm{ass{:}primitive\text{-}compatibility}\), continuity and compactness give
\[
 \kappa_0=\min_{a\in I}g_0(a)>0.
\]

We now construct the full law.  Let \(X\) be uniform on the nonempty finite set \(\mathcal X\).  Conditional on any \(X=x\), let \(A\) have density \(g_0\); equivalently, choose \(A\) independent of \(X\) with that density.  Take \(\mathcal V\) to be a one-point standard Borel space, let \(V\) be its constant random element, and define the jointly measurable map
\[
 h(a,x,V)=0,
 \quad Y(a)=0\quad(a\in\mathcal A),
 \quad Y=0,
\]
and take the displayed equalities on the whole sample space.  Put
\[
 C_e=\max\left\{\frac{3+3^{q_e}}4,
                         \frac{2+2^{q_e}}3\right\},
 \quad
 \delta=\left(\frac{M_e}{2C_e}\right)^{1/q_e}>0.
\]
Independently of \((A,X,V,Y(\cdot),Y)\) and independently of one another, choose
\[
 P(U_1=-\delta)=\frac34,\quad P(U_1=3\delta)=\frac14,
\]
and
\[
 P(U_2=-\delta)=\frac23,\quad P(U_2=2\delta)=\frac13.
\]
Finally set \(S_j=A+U_j\), \(j\in\{1,2\}\).  The two error means are
\[
 E[U_1]=-\frac34\delta+\frac14(3\delta)=0,
 \quad
 E[U_2]=-\frac23\delta+\frac13(2\delta)=0.
\]
Their absolute \(q_e\)-moments obey
\[
 E|U_1|^{q_e}=\frac{3+3^{q_e}}4\delta^{q_e}
 \le C_e\delta^{q_e}=\frac{M_e}{2},
\]
and
\[
 E|U_2|^{q_e}=\frac{2+2^{q_e}}3\delta^{q_e}
 \le C_e\delta^{q_e}=\frac{M_e}{2}.
\]
Each error law is asymmetric: a symmetric two-point law must put equal mass on its two support points, whereas the displayed masses are unequal.  They are mutually nonidentical because their support-and-mass pairs differ.  Product construction gives both error-coordinate independence and independence of the errors from all latent and outcome variables.  In particular, the location normalization for \(U_2\) and the common error-moment bound hold.

It remains to check every retained member property of \(\mathcal M\).  Uniformity and primitive compatibility give
\[
 p_x=|\mathcal X|^{-1}\ge p_{\min}>0.
\]
For every \(x\),
\[
 f_x=g_0,\quad m_x=0,\quad q_x=m_xf_x=0.
\]
Thus \(P(A\in\mathcal A)=1\), \(\|f_x\|_{H^\beta}=R_{f,0}\le R_f\), \(\|q_x\|_{H^\beta}=0\le R_q\), and
\[
 \inf_{a\in I}f_x(a)=\kappa_0\ge\kappa.
\]
The response equation holds on one common probability-one event, \(V\perp A\mid X\), consistency holds because \(Y=Y(A)=0\), and \(a\mapsto E[Y(a)\mid X=x]=0\) is continuous on \(I\).  Hence the constructed full-data law satisfies every retained item in \(\mathrm{def{:}model\text{-}class}\), proving \(\mathcal M\ne\varnothing\).

Project this law to
\[
 \vartheta_0=
 \bigl((|\mathcal X|^{-1},g_0,0)_{x\in\mathcal X},
       \mathcal L(U_1),\mathcal L(U_2)\bigr).
\]
The preceding calculations verify the mass, density, support, Sobolev, overlap, moment, and centering clauses in \(\mathrm{def{:}exact\text{-}projected\text{-}class}\); moreover \(|q_x|=0\le B_Yg_0\).  Therefore \(\vartheta_0\in\mathscr K\), so \(\mathscr K\ne\varnothing\) as well.
body.justification: A normalized smooth bump, zero response surface, and independent centered asymmetric nonidentical two-point errors give a complete full-law witness and a projected exact-class witness.
body.gap: This certifies nonvacuity only; it does not provide the strict Sobolev interior or contiguous Bernoulli packet required by the lower-bound OEQ.
body.consumer: The identification and honest-band theorems use it to make their uniform statements explicitly nonvacuous.
